text:
sam_customer: Hey team — onboarding our SparkPlug integration. Using browser SDK v0.9.2. We see intermittent 429s during initial app load. Spike ~50 parallel clients after deploy. Any quick mitigations?

alyssa_cs: Hi @sam_customer — welcome! Can you paste the exact error payload? Is it a 429 from our preflight endpoint or from an intermediate proxy?

sam_customer: 429 from api.redwood-inference.com/v1/preflight (preflight). Response body: {"error":"rate_limited", "retry_after":2}

jordan_eng: Are you using ephemeral tokens or a static key? If ephemeral, what's your refresh pattern?

sam_customer: Ephemeral tokens. We refresh on app start with no jitter — so at deploy we get ~50 parallel refreshes which looks like a fanout.

maria_support: Sounds like a thundering herd on preflight. Quick client-side fixes: add jittered splay and cap concurrent preflight requests. Also implement exponential backoff on 429s.

jordan_eng: Server-side note: we have a small onboarding burst allowance but it can be saturated. For large planned migrations we can temporarily increase your quota or whitelist traffic. @alyssa_cs can coordinate a short-term bump.

alyssa_cs: @jordan_eng will do. Sam — can you share your org_id and expected ramp (users/min) so I can request a temporary quota increase?

sam_customer: org_9X4. We're planning ~200 new sessions over ~3 minutes tomorrow for a migration. Also saw a couple of 401s in the logs — might be clock skew on client machines.

jordan_eng: 401s plus 429s is a two-headed problem. 401 often = JWT clock skew/signature. For browser clients check system time or issue tokens with a small leeway. For Node clients we recommend NTP. If you can paste an x-request-id from a 401 I'll trace it.

sam_customer: Sending logs now — x-request-id: req_abc123. Attaching a short snippet of our init code:

```
// client init
SDK.init({
  apiKey: 'ephemeral',
  onStart: () => refreshToken(),
  // currently unlimited parallel preflight
})
```

sam_customer: Also saw deploy at time of spike — maybe correlated.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deployment completed for sparkplug-frontend @ 2024-09-12T15:02:10Z :rocket:

jordan_eng: Got the logs. The 401s line up with client clocks ~+65s skew. That's why some refreshes fail and hit auth paths repeatedly. For 429s, I've opened an internal quota request. Alyssa filed CS-4321.

alyssa_cs: Filed CS-4321. Requested temporary onboarding quota to 1000 r/min for 24h. Will update when approved.

sam_customer: Thanks. We'll implement jitter and cap preflight to 5 concurrent requests now and re-deploy a canary to validate.

maria_support: :thumbsup: Ping us after the canary. We'll monitor preflight 429s and auth 401s. If issues persist we'll enable a targeted whitelist for your org during migration.

sam_customer: Will do — testing in staging this afternoon and will report results here. Appreciate the quick responses!
